summary: An ingest trace now says what the ingest did, instead of arriving empty.
details: Every ambient message opened a Langfuse trace whose root carried only a platform and a room key, and only the two refusing exits recorded an outcome at all — so an ordinary message that passed through cleanly produced a trace with six named stages and no statement of what happened. Every exit now records its outcome on the root: refused room, failed audit write, refused sender, engaged, or simply recorded.

The root also carries what tells one ingest from another without expanding a stage: which trigger the gate matched (including a gate that degraded closed, which previously read identically to an untagged message), whether the sender is somebody Nora knows, the conversation type, and how many attachments arrived.

One ambient message remains one trace. The trace was made informative rather than sampled away — an ingest that merely recorded a message is still the place a dropped attachment or an unmapped sender becomes visible.
limitations: Volume is unchanged: a busy room still produces one trace per message. If collector cost becomes the constraint, the intended answer is tail sampling at the collector keyed on the new outcome attribute, not dropping the span.
